red-text.comment: Darker variant of red for small/normal-weight text on light backgrounds — red alone only clears WCAG AA contrast at large text sizes

red-deep.comment: Darker variant of red for use as a background behind cream text — red alone only gives cream text ~4.0:1 contrast, below the 4.5:1 AA threshold

cream-dark.comment: Slightly darker background, for subtle fills

tape.value: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-mustard) 0%, var(--color-orange) 25%, var(--color-red) 50%, var(--color-red-deep) 75%, var(--color-plum) 100%)
tape.comment: The full five-stop sunset gradient, references CSS custom properties directly. Kept for header/toggle-scale decorative use. For any use with ink text on top (e.g. the masthead hero), use the narrower mustard→orange→red hero-gradient instead — red-deep and plum both fail contrast under ink text, see tokens/color.json comment history and Foundations → Colors.

hero.comment: Text-safe subset of the tape gradient (mustard→orange→red only) for use behind ink text — verified ink-on-red is 3.74:1, clearing the 3:1 large-text threshold; red-deep/plum are excluded because ink fails contrast against them (2.67:1 / 1.96:1).
